title: Parsnip crisps
preamble:
Ingedients
1 big fat parsnip
1 extra virgin olive oil
Salt and pepper

Ingedients

1 big fat parsnip

1 extra virgin olive oil

Salt and pepper

Method:-
Pre-heat oven to Gas Mark 5.
Peel the parsnip.
With a potato peeler, peel thick slices of parsnip.
Place in a bowl and cover with black pepper and then loads of olive oil.
Place singly on a baking sheet and place in centre of oven.
Roast in the centre of oven for 10 minutes then turn each piece.
Roast for a further 5 to 10 minutes, remembering that they continue to cook after removal from oven.
